title: StablePoint: gated activation harness for batch/cache suggestions
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Optimize produces batching and KV-cache configuration recommendations that significantly reduce token cost but can regress tail latency or correctness in a small fraction of workloads. We need a safe, operator-visible mechanism to automatically apply recommendations (when enabled) while minimizing customer risk and providing rapid, observable rollback.
scope: Design and implement a reusable rollout harness (StablePoint) that owns staged activation, simulated-canary validation, operator approval ceremony, audit logging, and automatic rollback triggers for batch/caching recommendations from Optimize. Work includes runtime flags, Console UI hooks, rollout controller, telemetry signals, and operator playbook.
out_of_scope: Model-retraining, offline eval tooling outside of simulated canary harness, and billing model changes.
acceptance_criteria: StablePoint controller can accept a suggestion bundle and start a phased activation using percentage-based traffic partitions: shadow -> 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%
Each phase must run a configurable hold window (default 30m) and evaluate a predefined set of metrics (p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, error rate, model output divergence score) before progressing
If any metric breaches a phase-specific threshold, StablePoint must automatically stop and rollback the active change within the same controller evaluation cycle

Operator approval flow available in Console requiring an explicit rationale and optional escrow TTL for manual holds; approvals are auditable and link to the underlying suggestion and telemetry snapshot
Simulated-canary (shadow run) mode must be available to replay 24h of production traffic through the candidate config without affecting responses, producing a cost/latency/correctness report
Events, decisions, and rollbacks must be recorded in the audit log with traceable request-level links and preserved for 90 days by default
E2E test harness with deterministic failure injection (latency/error spikes) that triggers rollback in CI
Runbook/checklist and a Console banner exist for operators to escalate or fast-fail a rollout
implementation_notes: Core controller: new StablePoint service (small stateful controller) that orchestrates staged activation and subscribes to Optimize suggestion events
Traffic partition: implement per-customer request-sampling policy that honors region and customer tier; use sticky sampling by tokenized request hash to avoid user-level flapping
Shadow-run bucket: forwarding copy of requests to the candidate runtime path with identical KV/batching logic; responses are discarded but compared for divergence metrics

Metrics and telemetry: require the following signals - p50/p95 latency, qps, token-per-response, 4xx/5xx error rates, output-distance (BLEU-like) to baseline for structured outputs, and tail-rate of KV cache misses
Thresholds: phase thresholds configurable per-model family. Default conservative thresholds: p95 latency regression <= +10% absolute, error-rate delta <= +0.05%, output-distance <= 0.02 normalized
Rollback mechanism: controller issues a config revert via the platform config API and records a rollback_reason. Rollbacks must be idempotent and support manual and automatic modes
Operator ceremony: Console modal to request 'escrowed apply' requiring at least one SRE or PM sign-off for P1+ customers; approvals stored as signed events linked to the suggestion id
Simulated-canary implementation: replay service reads sampled traces (configurable window) and runs them against candidate config; uses lightweight cache priming to approximate cold/hot scenarios
Staging buckets: use dynamic partition keys (customer_id, route_name) to ensure representative sampling across high/low qps customers
Runtime flags: feature flag for StablePoint per-customer; rollout flags for enabling automatic apply vs. manual only
Audit & tracing: attach trace id to each rollout event and include links to GPU-level telemetry in the rollout record
Safety net: global circuit breaker that halts all in-flight StablePoint rollouts if platform-wide error-rate or capacity alarms trigger
Observability: Console dashboard summarizing active rollouts, progress, recent rollbacks, and per-phase metric deltas
Performance: ensure shadow runs are rate-limited and use sampling to bound overhead to <1% extra p99 latency impact for serving fleet
testing_plan: Unit tests for controller progression logic and threshold evaluation (fast path and failure path)
Integration tests: deploy StablePoint against a test cluster with synthetic traffic generators that exercise batch sizes and KV cache hit/miss patterns
Chaos tests: inject delayed responses and targeted 5xx for the candidate path to ensure rollback triggers reliably
Simulated-canary validation in staging with 48h trace replay and automated comparison report
Canary in production: small subset of internal customers with explicit opt-in and monitoring of rollback sensitivity
CI gating: require the e2e rollback test to pass before merging controller changes
Load test: verify shadow-run overhead at 5% sampling on a high-throughput model without breaching p99 latency SLO
monitoring_and_alerts: Per-rollout alert: phase_stalled (no progress for > hold_window + 15m)
Threshold breach alert: emits when any phase metric crosses threshold; auto-notify on-call SRE and product owner
Global alarm: if >3 automatic rollbacks occur within 1 hour for different customers, pause autonomous applies cluster-wide
Console notification: rollout completed/rolled back with reason and link to the report
SLO guard: if platform p95 latency increases by >5% sustained for 10m, pause all StablePoint progression
